comment: Two jacks carry no label on the panel: the one under DEPTH is the depth CV and the one under the level slider is the VCA CV, each tied to its control by a hairline. The VCA input was added in 2.5.7, after the manual was written, and the manual read here (Manuals/CAP_Manual_EN.md at this commit) does describe it. Rack's own bypass routes left to left and right to right and does not reproduce the internal right-input normalling.
